title: Fault Tree Analysis
subtitle: Top Event - System Intermittently Fails During Startup Validation

top_event.label: System Intermittently Fails During Startup Validation
top_event.description: The unit sometimes fails to complete startup validation after overnight storage and requires a full power cycle to recover.

event_detail.title: Event Detail
event_detail.text: The unit sometimes fails to complete startup validation after overnight storage and requires a full power cycle to recover.
bullets: Observed across mixed environmental chambers during validation
Failure appears after long idle time followed by cold startup
Scope includes engineering samples from two assembly lots
Impact is delayed shipment qualification until root cause is isolated
